headline: AZB, Hogan Lovells, CAM, Linklaters act on Aegis Logistics ₹3,500 crore QIP
sum: Aegis Logistics Limited has raised ₹3,500 crore from a Qualified Institutions Placement of 2,89,25,619 equity shares. AZB & Partners and Hogan Lovells Cadwalader acted as the Indian counsel and international counsel for Aegis Logistics on…
detail: Aegis Logistics Limited has raised ₹3,500 crore from a Qualified Institutions Placement of 2,89,25,619 equity shares. AZB & Partners and Hogan Lovells Cadwalader acted as the Indian counsel and international counsel for Aegis Logistics on this QIP, respectively. Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised the Placement Agents on this QIP. J.P.
